title: Wiser Advisor
subtitle: Website Design and Development
details:
For the Wiser Adviser Group project, I developed a comprehensive website that effectively communicates the company's unique position in financial adviser training and development.

Working closely with the business owner, I crafted a professional online presence that highlights their 25+ years of industry expertise and specialized training programs. The site clearly articulates how Wiser Adviser helps financial professionals accelerate their career growth while improving their institutions' profitability.

Built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP, the website features responsive design elements that ensure seamless functionality across all devices. I implemented clean navigation and information hierarchy to guide visitors through the company's service offerings, credentials, and track record of delivering double-digit sales improvements. The collaborative development process with the business owner ensured the final product accurately represented their vision and business goals while meeting modern web standards.
